channel.title: Music Business Worldwide (MBW) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music Business Worldwide (MBW) (musicbusinessworldwide.com)

item.title: David Checa joins Warner Chappell Music Colombia as Managing Director
item.description: The industry veteran will oversee WCM’s operations in one of Latin America’s most influential music markets. Source

item.title: Saul Fitton joins PULSE Music Group as Senior Vice President/Head of Creative, UK
item.description: London-based Fitton previously served as Senior Director, A&R for Sony Music Publishing and A&R Manager at Warner Chappell Music Source

item.title: Spotify says it paid out over $11bn to the music industry in 2025
item.description: The streaming giant has hailed the figure as "the largest annual payment to music from any retailer in history". Source

item.title: Pam Schoenfeld appointed SVP, Chief Legal Officer at BMI
item.description: Schoenfeld succeeds Stuart Rosen, who will continue as Senior Legal Advisor until June 30, 2026 Source

item.title: GoldState hires ex-HarbourView exec Rabih Aouad as Principal to lead investments in tech, services and other music-related businesses
item.description: Aouad will support GoldState's 'growth equity strategy within the global music ecosystem' Source

item.title: Primary Wave makes strategic investment in music financing platform RUN
item.description: RUN says it has already deployed 'tens of millions of dollars in capital to hundreds of artists across five continents' Source

item.title: Marion Gargula and Laurent Pernin promoted to co-General Managers at BMG France
item.description: The duo have also been elevated to Vice Presidents at the company. Source

item.title: OpenWav fan app launched by Wyclef Jean and 88rising’s Jaeson Ma forms joint venture with Loud House for new artist commerce platform
item.description: The new project seeks to provide artists and IP owners a way to launch, test and scale consumer products globally without holding inventory. Source

item.title: UMG sues Anthropic for $3bn over ‘brazen’ copyright infringement of 20,000+ songs
item.description: Music publishers file second copyright infringement lawsuit against AI company Anthropic Source

item.title: Sony launches $2B music rights acquisition JV with Singapore’s GIC
item.description: Sony Music Group is forming a music rights-buying joint venture with Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund, GIC Pte. Source
